description: Normative statements of spec/syntax.md that the WG suite does not test: mf2-two's own tests, written from the spec in the suite's schema (plans/01-conformance.md §5; conformance/coverage.toml).

tests.description: [S1] An input declaration cannot bind a variable its own function's options use (syntax.md, Declarations).
[S2] A backslash in text must begin an escape sequence (syntax.md, Text).
[S2] …nor escape a character that is not backslash, brace or bar.
[S3] A backslash in a quoted literal must begin an escape sequence (syntax.md, Literals).
[S4] Markup must end with a right brace (syntax.md, Markup).
[S5] A repeated attribute name is valid; attributes do not affect output (syntax.md, Attributes).
[S6] A quoted literal cannot contain U+0000 (syntax.md, Literals).
